preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string S for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The length of each string S must match the specified length N for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for S in test_cases for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S must be a lowercase English letter.
The sum of the lengths of all strings S across all test cases must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to make the string S a palindrome, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES'.
If it is possible to make the string S a palindrome, output the minimum number of operations required.
